title: godmode
script:
--[[
  WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
local syn = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/necodehacks/RobloxScripts/refs/heads/main/whatsfuck.lua"))()

local window = syn:createWindow({
    Title = "ImGui-Astroma"
})
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local pl = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local chr = pl.Character
local hrp = chr:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")


local god = false
window:createToggle("God-Mode", function(state)
god = state
if state then
task.spawn(function()
while god do
task.wait(0.5)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").SwordDamage:FireServer(pl, -math.huge, "fuck_nil", pl.UserId)
end
end)
end
end)


window:createButton("Kill-All", function()
for _, plrs in next, (game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plrs ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer and plrs.Character then
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").SwordDamage:FireServer(plrs, math.huge, "BlueEpicness", pl.UserId)
end
end
end)

local n = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.SwordInventory.Swords
window:createButton("Unlock All Weapons", function()
for _, folder in next, (n:GetChildren()) do
if folder:IsA("Folder")  then
for _, hack in next, (folder:GetChildren()) do
if hack:IsA("Model") then
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Events.Swords.UnlockSword:FireServer(hack.Name)
end
end
end
end
end)
